item.title: what i learned about caching
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months caching bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Caching shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: rethinking pagination
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I spent a while getting pagination wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Pagination shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
